verification.method: Anonymous OCI HTTP GET; SHA-256 verified for manifests, configurations and every referenced layer

signatureProvenance: Signature status comes from the original GitLab publication records, including nine current publication-only receipts. The anonymous full-download check did not repeat cryptographic signature verification. Fifteen legacy Secure records lack complete signed annotation values in this catalog; obtain them from the linked original publication record.
evidenceAccess: Publication job links and retained qualification evidence may require GitLab access.
